set.body:
The hardened graphics core (typed AesEnv, phased Plot -> TrainedPlot -> Scene -> DeviceScene -> backend pipeline, scale-derived guides, layout solver, renderer conformance contract, four passing backends: SVG, Canvas, Java2D, JavaFX) graded as a rigorous kernel: roughly all of grid plus ~15% of ggplot2. This epic operationalizes a fresh grading into a single roadmap: fix the one real soundness hole, then climb three completeness tiers, and finish extraction-ready.

Identity to protect (already special, keep it): single-point unit/orientation/handedness resolution in DeviceScene.fromScene (backends are dumb y-down interpreters); byte-deterministic output on JVM and JS (no log10, no Double.toString in Breaks.pretty/Labeler); the renderer conformance contract (portable, backend-neutral, four backends pass); typed diagnostics (DroppedRow + PlotDropReason, TrainedPlot inspectable before render). Every issue here must preserve the renderer-neutral pipeline, keep the conformance contract green, and pass JVM+JS tests.

General-purpose, not neuroimaging. This is a grammar-of-graphics library; neuroimaging is one consumer. Verified extractable: the graphics core and all four backends import nothing outside scalafim.graphics; the graphics crossProject has no dependsOn in build.sbt; the only inbound edge is domain modules (design, etc.) depending ON graphics. The extraction-readiness track keeps it that way and packages it as a standalone cross-published library.

Structure (see child issues, tagged tier0/tier1/tier2/tier3 + extraction):
- Tier 0 soundness: plot-global scale training (the one coherence hole), stroke cap/join in the contract, resolve the dead Grob.Group.gp field.
- Tier 1 blocks real use: axis/plot titles, theme (panel background + grid lines), continuous color guide (colorbar), science geoms (ribbon/errorbar/hline+vline/tile) + rect, fixed aspect ratio.
- Tier 2 structural: facets, typed stats (bin/summary/density), discrete/band position scales, platform text metrics, heterogeneous layers.
- Tier 3 polish/creed: reconcile declared-but-rejected enum members, unify AesSpec/AesEnv, legend placement via TextMetrics, a traverse helper, decide+document Geom.Line ordering.
Capstone: user-facing DSL, then the 10/10 re-grade gate.

Reframes the earlier target-10 epic (bd-01KX2HRDJB08TM7GVCFR8E2PKD) with an evidence-graded tier structure and absorbs its children. The hardening + first-backends phases of the roadmap epic (bd-01KX30QRM91PC04H73T4XX40H5) are done.
set.title: Epic: graphics as a general plotting library — soundness + three-tier completeness toward extraction
